## Edge cases

| case | HTTP | response |
|---|---|---|
| no stop within walking distance (field near Delhi border) | 422 | no bus stop within 1500 m of the origin |
| 2 am query (no service) | 200 | 3 options; warnings: — |
| invalid coordinates | 422 | 999.0,999.0 is outside the Delhi service area |
| outside Delhi (Mumbai) | 422 | 19.07,72.87 is outside the Delhi service area |
| same origin and destination | 200 | 0 options; warnings: origin and destination are the same place — just walk |
| unknown stop name | 422 | unknown place 'zzqqxx' — use 'lat,lon' or a bus stop name |
| bad time format | 400 | depart must be ISO date-time (e.g. 2026-10-27T08:30) or HH:MM, got 'tomorrow-ish' |
| bad mode | 400 | mode must be one of ['fastest', 'balanced', 'comfortable'] |
| missing 'to' | 422 | [{'type': 'missing', 'loc': ['query', 'to'], 'msg': 'Field required', 'input': None}] |
| very short trip (300 m) | 200 | 1 options; warnings: — |
| typo in stop name | 200 | 3 options; warnings: — |

| matrix 3×3 | 200 | ok |
